Shift a plain notice for people travelling soon
With that in mind

Travelers should check their companion animal papers before arriving at Aurelia Skyways. Keep the animal calm, carry the usual supplies, and make sure the carrier is ready for security checks and cabin rules. The Companion Animal Travel Desk can help you sort out forms, transport steps, and questions about smooth check in. <<FACT F082>> Bring a clean carrier, fresh bedding, and any items your animal may need on the trip.

Our staff gives patient attention to every animal and helps travelers move through the process without confusion. If plans change, let the desk know as early as you can so the senior coordinator can guide the next steps and keep your trip organized.

Please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for help with your travel papers and animal arrangements.
